description.value:
Cybersuite · Neuralware, Hospital, HL 7 (2d6), 1 Neural Link slot. Requires a Neuroport. Installs one Cyberdeck inside your Neuroport, Hardware slots and all: 20m to architectures, 50m to Neuroports and vehicles. Swapping the deck is a Clinic job (1 hour).

Built-in quickhacks (take no deck slots, can't be removed): Ping, E-Reader

+2 to notice a Ghosted Netrunner in your port, and +2 to eject one.

1,000eb (Very Expensive).
